name: Indian National Congress
summary: The Indian National Congress declares this date as Independence Day, or as the day for Purna Swaraj (Complete Independence). The Indian National Congress (INC), also known as the Congress Party, or simply the Congress, is a big tent political party in India. It is India’s oldest political party and is widely regarded as one of the world’s oldest continuously active political parties, outside Europe and North America.

name: first patent for a field-effect transistor is granted in the United State...
summary: The first patent for a field-effect transistor is granted in the United States, to Julius Edgar Lilienfeld. The development drew international attention and influenced later political, social, or strategic decisions connected to the period. Its consequences helped shape how governments and the public understood the wider changes underway.

name: Rafael Trujillo
summary: Rafael Trujillo is elected president of the Dominican Republic. The political change influenced the direction of government policy and the country's response to the major domestic and international pressures of the period. It also affected later alliances, reforms, or public debates.

name: Amy Johnson
summary: Amy Johnson lands in Darwin, Australia, becoming the first woman to fly solo from England to Australia (she left on May 5 for the 11,000 mile flight). Amy Johnson (born 1 July 1903 – disappeared 5 January 1941) was a pioneering English pilot who was the first woman to fly solo from London to Australia.

name: 1930 Argentine coup d'état
summary: 1930 Argentine coup d'état: José Félix Uriburu carries out a military coup, overthrowing Hipólito Yrigoyen, President of Argentina. The 1930 Argentine coup d'état, also known as the September Revolution by its supporters, involved the overthrow of the Argentine government of Hipólito Yrigoyen by forces loyal to General José Félix Uriburu. The coup took place on 6 September 1930 when Uriburu led a small detachment of troops into the capital, experiencing no substantial opposition and taking control of the Casa Rosada.

name: German Socialist Labour Party in Poland – Left
summary: The German Socialist Labour Party in Poland – Left is founded, following a split in the DSAP in Łódź. The German Socialist Labour Party in Poland – Left (German: Deutsche Sozialistische Arbeitspartei in Polen – Linke, DSAP–Linke; Polish: Niemiecka Socjalistyczna Partia Robotnicza w Polsce – Lewica) was a political party in the Second Polish Republic.

name: Revolution of 1930
summary: Revolution of 1930: Getúlio Vargas overthrows Washington Luís. The Revolution of 1930 (Portuguese: Revolução de 1930) was an armed insurrection across Brazil that ended the Old Republic. The revolution replaced incumbent president Washington Luís with defeated presidential candidate and revolutionary leader Getúlio Vargas, concluding the political hegemony of a four-decade-old oligarchy and beginning the Vargas Era.

name: London Naval Treaty
summary: Ratifications are exchanged in London on the first London Naval Treaty signed in April, modifying the Washington Naval Treaty of 1922. Its arms limitation provisions go into effect immediately, hence putting more limits on the expensive naval arms race between its five signatories (the United Kingdom, the United States, the Empire of Japan, France and Italy.)

name: Cecil George Paine, a pathologist at the Sheffield Royal Infirmary in Eng...
summary: Cecil George Paine, a pathologist at the Sheffield Royal Infirmary in England, achieves the first recorded cure (of an eye infection) using penicillin. Its consequences helped shape how governments and the public understood the wider changes underway.
